items.title: Risk of Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension Following Anemia in Young Adults: A Retrospective Cohort TriNetX Database Study.
items.abstract: Anemia has been associated with idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH) in small studies, but whether severity modulates IIH risk remains unclear. This study evaluated the hazard of incident IIH after mild, moderate, and severe anemia in young adults. Using the TriNetX Research Network (111) health care organizations), adults aged 18-50 years with persistent anemia (≥2 hemoglobin values) were stratified as mild (11.0-12.9 g/dL), moderate (8.0-10.9 g/dL), or severe (<8.0 g/dL) and matched 1:1 to controls (Hb ≥ 13.0 g/dL) by propensity score matching on demographics, body mass index, comorbidities, and socioeconomic factors. The primary outcome was incident IIH; Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs) at 6 months, 1 year, and 3 years. Sensitivity analyses applied the World Health Organization (WHO) women's mild threshold and compared patients with vs without iron supplementation. After matching, 1,240,670 mild anemia patients (mean age 29.0 ± 8.7 years, 83.4% female), 666,515 moderate (29.7 ± 8.1, 86.3% female), and 114,785 severe (31.0 ± 8.9, 75.4% female) were compared with equal-sized control cohorts. Hazard of incident IIH was elevated at every severity and time interval. At 6 months, HRs were 1.45 (95% CI 1.29-1.63), 1.61 (1.39-1.86), and 2.53 (1.82-3.52) for mild, moderate, and severe anemia. At 1 year, HRs were 1.35 (1.22-1.49), 1.33 (1.17-1.51), and 1.94 (1.46-2.58). At 3 years, HRs were 1.17 (1.08-1.26), 1.15 (1.04-1.27), and 1.40 (1.11-1.76); all estimates remained significantly elevated, although CIs overlapped across severity bands. The WHO women's threshold sensitivity yielded concordant, modestly stronger estimates (6 months: HR 1.99 [1.73-2.30]; 3 years: 1.43 [1.31-1.58]). Iron supplementation was associated with reduced IIH hazard (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.62-0.93; n = 340,660 per group). Anemia is associated with elevated hazard of incident IIH in young adults across all severity bands. Point estimates were higher with greater anemia severity and at earlier follow-up, but CIs overlapped across severity bands, so a severity gradient could not be established. Iron supplementation was associated with reduced hazard. Findings are limited by observational design, administrative case identification, and low absolute incidence; anemia represents a potentially modifiable factor warranting evaluation in patients with papilledema.
items.summary_ja:
背景：若年成人における特発性頭蓋内高血圧症（IIH）と貧血の関連は小規模研究で示唆されているが、貧血の重症度がIIHリスクに与える影響は不明であった。  
方法：TriNetXデータベースを用い、18～50歳の持続的貧血患者を軽度（Hb 11.0-12.9 g/dL）、中等度（8.0-10.9 g/dL）、重度（<8.0 g/dL）に分類し、貧血なし（Hb ≥13.0 g/dL）の対照群と1対1で傾向スコアマッチングした。主要評価項目は新規IIH発症で、6か月、1年、3年時点でハザード比（HR）を算出。鉄剤補充の影響も検討した。  
結果：各重症度群の患者数はそれぞれ約124万、67万、11万名で、全ての重症度と期間でIIH発症リスクが有意に上昇。6か月時点のHRは軽度1.45、中等度1.61、重度2.53。鉄剤補充はIIHリスクを有意に低減（HR 0.75）した。  
結論：若年成人の貧血は重症度にかかわらずIIH発症リスクを高め、鉄剤補充がリスク低減に寄与する可能性が示唆された。観察研究の限界はあるが、貧血は視神経乳頭浮腫患者の評価における修正可能な因子と考えられる。
items.summary_short_ja: 若年成人における貧血と特発性頭蓋内高血圧症（IIH）の発症リスクを後ろ向きコホート研究で検討した。軽度から重度の貧血すべてでIIHリスクが有意に上昇し、重症度が高いほどリスクも高い傾向があったが、明確な重症度依存性は示されなかった。鉄剤補充はIIHリスクを低減させる可能性が示唆された。観察研究のため因果関係は不明だが、貧血はIIHの修正可能なリスク因子として注目される。

items.title: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension Prevalence and Hormonal Contraception: A Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract: Women's health advice in people living with idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH) is inconsistent, primarily due to an enduring concern that hormonal contraception (HC), including oral contraceptive pills (OCPs) and hormonal intrauterine devices (IUDs), might be associated with a higher prevalence of IIH. This systematic review and meta-analysis examines whether a meaningful association exists between HC use and IIH prevalence. Systematic searches of Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were conducted from their inception to May 14, 2025. Gray literature and citation lists were also reviewed. Observational studies comparing HC use among women with IIH to controls without IIH were included. Noncomparative studies and pharmacovigilance analyses were excluded. Two independent reviewers conducted data extraction, assessed the quality of studies using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and appraised the certainty of evidence using the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation framework. A random-effects meta-analysis using the Mantel-Haenszel method in Review Manager 5.4 was conducted to evaluate the association between HC use and IIH prevalence, the primary outcome of interest, with leave-one-out sensitivity analyses and subgroup analyses stratified by HC modality. A total of 13 studies (n The meta-analysis found no significant association between HC use and IIH prevalence, with consistent results across various HC modalities. This evidence provides confidence to reassure patients with IIH and clinicians that the directed use of HC should be continued as appropriate. The limited quality of available evidence and considerable heterogeneity highlights the necessity for large-scale, well-designed studies, particularly in diverse patient populations, to validate these findings.
items.summary_ja:
【背景】特発性頭蓋内高血圧症（IIH）患者に対する女性の健康指導は一貫性を欠き、経口避妊薬（OCP）やホルモン内避妊具（IUD）を含むホルモン避妊法（HC）がIIHの発症率を高める可能性への懸念が根強い。  
【方法】Ovid MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane Libraryを用いて2025年5月までの関連観察研究を系統的に検索し、IIH患者と非患者のHC使用状況を比較した13件の研究を対象にメタアナリシスを実施。研究の質はNewcastle-Ottawa Scaleで評価し、証拠の確実性はGRADEで検討。ランダム効果モデルを用い、HCの種類別のサブグループ解析も行った。  
【結果】HC使用とIIH発症率の間に有意な関連は認められず、各種HCモダリティにおいても一貫した結果が得られた。  
【結論】IIH患者に対してHCの使用を継続することは安全であると示唆されるが、利用可能な証拠の質が限定的かつ異質性が高いため、多様な患者集団を対象とした大規模で質の高い研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 特発性頭蓋内圧亢進症（IIH）とホルモン避妊法（HC）の関連性を検討した13件の観察研究を対象としたメタ解析により、HC使用とIIHの有病率に有意な関連は認められなかった。経口避妊薬やホルモンIUDを含む各種HCモダリティでも同様の結果であり、IIH患者へのHC使用継続は安心して推奨できる。ただし、研究の質や異質性に限界があり、多様な集団を対象とした大規模研究が今後必要である。
